prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART terrain PROP sprite sheet, transparent PNG. Exactly THREE distinct isolated objects in one horizontal row, separated by WIDE fully transparent gutters, each fully within its own cell, each object sits on SAME baseline. Match detailed dark-fantasy pocket/chibi RPG pixel-art trees and heroes, sharp pixel clusters and dark plum outlines, rich crafted pixels NOT low-poly or voxel shapes. Three-quarter RPG camera from above about35degrees. LEFT: low broad organic grassy rise, irregular rounded asymmetric profile with several small contours, dark earth under torn moss, embedded gray pebbles, tufted grass and tiny roots. MIDDLE: another distinct low hillside, long gentle broken ridge, moss, a ledge of layered rock exposed at one end, tufts and tiny fallen leaves; DIFFERENT silhouette. RIGHT: medium-height rugged natural rocky outcrop, irregular weather-worn layered slate boulders, soft eroded fissures, moss ledges, roots, with a highly irregular silhouette. All read as part of natural terrain, NO artificial tiled cube, NO pyramid, NO triangle mountain symbols, NO square or hexagonal base, NO floating terrain platform, NO geometric block, NO symmetrical structure, NO trees, no people, no architecture, no text, no effects, no background or big ground shadow. Dark melancholy Belle Epoque world. Desaturated olive moss and cold charcoal-gray stone, low saturation so heroes stand out. Lighting top-left diffuse. Detailed but readable at 90px object width. Woodland variant: muted olive moss, gray limestone, brown earth, sparse tiny ochre leaves and very small ferns.
